ev.text: Fine early morning for it, Mira.
Dorn! I was hoping to run into you.
The fields look good this year.
My grandmother swore the old ruins were a lord's hall once.
Will you be at the Tankard tonight, Sylvi?
They do. A full store makes for an easier winter.
It is. Let us hope the night is as quiet.
And here I am. What is on your mind?
I would not miss it. First round is yours.
Mine said worse things were buried there than lords.
Nothing at all. It is just good to see a friendly face.
If the dead leave us in peace to bring it in.

entry.text: Brenna and Vex have tonight's watch.
